name: mnemonic_catalyst_cannon
label: Self-Sustainer's Sacrifice
godotFeature: ShaderMaterial, VisualServer, ParticleSystem, Resource System, GDScript, AnimationPlayer
poeticVision: Feel the agonizing weight of choice in every trigger pull. The rush of desperate power as a cherished memory burns away, leaving an echo of who you were, but ensuring you survive *this* moment. It's the constant tug-of-war between physical survival and the slow, inevitable erosion of self, forcing you to ask: What part of me am I willing to sacrifice to see tomorrow?

parameters.name: weapon_mesh
parameters.description: Path to the MeshInstance3D node representing the weapon's visual model.

parameters.name: particle_system
parameters.description: Path to the GPUParticles3D node used for dissipating memory shards.

parameters.name: animation_player
parameters.description: Path to the AnimationPlayer node for weapon firing animations (requires 'fire_animation').

parameters.name: base_shader_material
parameters.description: The ShaderMaterial resource that uses 'mnemonic_catalyst_cannon.gdshader'. It will be duplicated and modified at runtime.

verdict: A brilliant, agonizing mechanism that weaves the very fabric of identity into the desperate struggle for survival, ensuring every victory is etched with the bittersweet taste of self-loss.
impact: This invention transforms every combat encounter into a harrowing ethical dilemma, forcing players to confront the true cost of survival as they literally burn away their past to secure their future, making each trigger pull a moment of profound personal sacrifice. It deepens the emotional stakes of every action, ensuring that the player's identity is not just a narrative element, but a tangible, depletable resource.
